status: integrated as a host-side advisory, OFF by default; NOT qualified for live use

component.interface: VisionCaution(...).assess(frames=(prev, cur) 48x48 grey float in [0,1], proposed_action in 0..4, frame_ids=(prev_id, cur_id)) -> VisionCautionAdvisory
component.no_all_clear: There is no 'safe' status. 'no_caution_raised' only means the score is below the calibrated threshold.
component.enable: environment FERRUM_VISION_CAUTION=advisory or VisionCaution(enabled=True); default is disabled
component.output: a JSON record (schema ferrum_vision_caution_advisory_v1) to logs/telemetry only

authority_boundary.authority: advisory diagnostic only; no permit, block, approval, adapter or actuation authority
enforced_by: the artifact metadata authority string (load_artifact rejects any other value) and VisionCautionAdvisory, which refuses a different authority value

no consumer in the guest: nothing under userland/ (heliox-daemon, physical-runtime, the authority gate) references the package, its artifact or its env var (checked by scripts/verify_vision_caution_advisory.py)

the score is never constructed as a PhysicalPrediction (that type still carries fail-closed block influence in safety.rs) and the package has no route to ferrum_routed_command_v1, BridgeCommand, execute_tool, neural_intent_commit or physical_maintenance_demo (checked by the tests and the verifier)

fail-safe: every doubt (disabled, missing/altered/non-finite artifact, encoder digest mismatch, invalid/obscured/stale/out-of-order frames, unknown action, timeout, non-finite output, internal error) yields no_confident_caution with a logged reason, never an exception and never an all-clear
authority_boundary.deterministic_gate: unchanged; remains the sole permit authority

vision_caution_head.evaluated_by: docs/research/vision_world_model_result_v4_dinov2.json (sealed seed 781, amendment 3; persisted before the open under amendment 4)
vision_caution_head.encoder: facebook/dinov2-small model.safetensors, sha256 recorded in the artifact metadata and re-checked at load

qualification.qualified_for: advisory logging on rendered pybullet hard scenes, clean look, the five-action sim action space
not_qualified_for: the runtime PhysicalActionKind action space (7 kinds + 3 features), which differs from the sim action space

evidence.sealed_sim: vision_world_model_result_v4_dinov2.json: AUC-PR 0.634, recall 0.319 at realized FPR 0.087 (margin-calibrated), beats the from-scratch CNN by +0.038 recall (CI [0.015, 0.060])
evidence.appearance_shift: vision_world_model_domain_shift_v1.json and _shift_ablation_v1.json: appearance shift drives pixel-trained models toward chance; the pretrained encoder resists viewpoint/lighting shift but not sensor noise
evidence.real_footage_other_domain: vision_world_model_ccd_result_v1.json (dashcam crash anticipation): tests the approach on real video in a different domain; it does not qualify this head

promotion_conditions: A sealed, single-open evaluation on real footage of the deployment domain (the actual camera and scene), with labels for the hazard the advisory claims to anticipate, passing pre-registered gates including a held false-alarm budget calibrated on real benign footage with the half-budget margin.
An explicit mapping from the runtime action space to the head's action input, re-evaluated under that mapping.
A written authority-boundary review before any consumer inside userland/ is added; a vision score must never be passed as a PhysicalPrediction.
Until then the component stays off by default and advisory-only.
